audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Body Slam a knockback in five places (whys[1], spikes[0], spikes[2], early, wants.foe[1]) — it is a stun that lands on collision with the first unit hit. The full layer calls it a stun but invents a mechanic for it: 'the second cast is the stun'. Body Slam has no second cast. Neither layer mentions that the stun cancels Meditate, that Drunken Rage is an auto reset whose wind-up is the tell, or that Happy Hour heals him after every spell cast.
audit.why: Knockback vs stun changes the whole plan: a knockback breaks your chase and you re-approach, a stun holds you in place for his whole combo and cancels your channel. Explosive Cask is the actual knockback in his kit, and the entry conflates the two. Grievous Wounds timing against Happy Hour is what decides the extended fight the win condition is built on.
audit.corrected: Body Slam restated as a collision stun in whys[1], spikes[0], mid and wants.foe[1]; the invented second cast removed from breakdown.cooldowns and focus.text (and the loading line that quotes it); Meditate cancellation, the Drunken Rage reset tell and Happy Hour anti-heal written in.
